history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Describe the objects, background, style, lighting, color palette, and mood in detail. Do NOT include any introductory or concluding conversational text. Do not say 'Here is the prompt' or similar. Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

A young man with dark, tousled hair, wearing a navy blue and white varsity jacket with a large yellow "D" on the left chest, takes a mirror selfie. The jacket has white sleeves and navy blue body with white trim on the collar and cuffs. He is wearing a black t-shirt underneath, which has a graphic print on it. The background appears to be a bathroom with white tiled walls and a beige-colored door or wall in the reflection. The lighting is bright, coming from the phone's flash, creating a strong lens flare and reflecting off the mirror and the man's jacket. The overall mood is casual and youthful, with a slightly candid feel due to the mirror selfie format and the bright flash. The color palette is dominated by the navy blue and white of the jacket, with contrasting yellow and the neutral tones of the background.
